sn22.77:1.5: yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ …pe…
sn22.77:2.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃpi nibbindati vedanāyapi. saññāyapi. saṅkhāresupi. viññāṇasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn22.77:2.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.77:2.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn22.77:2.4: yāvatā bhikkhave sattāvāsā yāvatā bhavaggaṃ ete aggā ete seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ arahantoti.
